## Section B — BUG-304 Interaction (CRITICAL — same files, implemented yesterday)

> BUG-304 added `discountableRatio`, `dSgst/dCgst/dVat` split buckets, and `itemGstPostDiscount` to `CollectPaymentPanel.jsx` and `CartPanel.jsx`. CR-137 does NOT touch these lines but shares state scope.

| # | Priority | Description | Pass Criteria |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | P0 | Apply discount + reason → verify GST on bill is correct (same as without reason) | GST total = `(discountableGst × (1-discountableRatio)) + nonDiscountableGst` — unchanged |
| B2 | P0 | Cart with mixed discountable + non-discountable items → apply discount + reason → GST shown | Non-discountable item GST unchanged; discountable item GST correctly reduced |
| B3 | P0 | `discountFor` state does NOT affect `discountableRatio` computation | Add reason text → GST on screen does not change |
| B4 | P1 | Apply preset discount → reason input appears → total/GST correct | Preset discount still correctly uses `discountableTotal` denominator |
| B5 | P1 | Open CollectPaymentPanel twice (two orders sequentially) → `discountFor` state is fresh (empty) on second open | Reason from order 1 does not bleed into order 2 |
| B6 | P1 | CartPanel QSR — `discountableRatio` + `vatAmount` (BUG-304 fix) still correct after CR-137 changes | VAT amount on QSR collect-bill screen unchanged |

## Section D — Discount × Coupon × Loyalty × Wallet Interaction

> `CollectPaymentPanel.jsx` manages the interlock between discount, coupon, loyalty, and wallet. `discountFor` state must not interfere with any of these interlocks.

| # | Priority | Description | Pass Criteria |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | P0 | Apply coupon → discount section disabled → reason input does NOT appear | Reason input hidden when coupon is active |
| D2 | P0 | Apply discount + reason → try to apply coupon → coupon is blocked | "Discount blocks coupon" message still shows; reason input still visible |
| D3 | P1 | Apply manual discount + reason → apply loyalty points | Loyalty points still deducted correctly; reason field unaffected |
| D4 | P1 | Apply preset discount + reason → apply wallet | Wallet amount still deducted correctly |
| D5 | P1 | Switch from discount to coupon (clear discount) → `discountFor` cleared | After clearing discount (None), reason input is gone AND state is empty |
| D6 | P2 | Coupon applied → remove coupon → apply discount + reason | Reason input appears fresh after coupon removal; empty |
